response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS n FROM rental re JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = re.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), s AS (SELECT rating, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM r), a AS (SELECT s.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS combined_rented_films, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share
